name: r1_abs
change: baseline MLP: predicts log trip energy directly; physics integrals are only inputs

name: r2_corr
change: predict a correction to the generic road-load physics estimate (TransitNet lesson)

name: r3_maf
change: dev twin rung: MAF label model (OBD MAF fuel estimates read idle-level fuel during fuel cut-off); flag input says when the target is such an estimate

name: r4_rw
change: dev twin rung: on-road loads the simulator misses (A/C, accessories, real-world hybrid operation), fitted on label-matched dev twins; not applied to dynamometer tests

name: r5_phev
change: dev twin rung: plug-in hardware patch (pack power >= 1.2 x motor, power-cell resistance, MG2 torque) so simulated charge-depleting trips stay electric like the dev Volt and Energi

name: r6_ens
change: ensemble of 5 networks (different seeds); sigma includes their spread
